visual.name: tssmaps4powerbi
visual.description: TSS Maps for Power BI control provides bi-directional interaction with ArcGIS map layers

dataRoles.name: location
dataRoles.description: Geographic data type used to represent location of data on the map. Accepts addresses, postal codes, counties, states/provinces, or countries

dataRoles.name: geometry
dataRoles.description: GeoJSON used to create geometry objects with Power BI data.

dataRoles.name: latitude
dataRoles.description: Latitude data used to define the latitude values of a map coordinates. To use this data you must have the 'Latitude' and 'Longitude' fields occupied.

dataRoles.name: longitude
dataRoles.description: Longitude data used to define the longitude values of a map coordinates. To use this data you must have the 'Latitude' and 'Longitude' fields occupied.

dataRoles.name: query
dataRoles.description: Data used to connect and query reference layer with Power BI data.

dataRoles.name: differentiator
dataRoles.description: The field that will be used to differentiate and title different geometry layers

dataRoles.name: startTime
dataRoles.description: The field that will be used to define the starting temporal values of geometry objects.

dataRoles.name: endTime
dataRoles.description: The field that will be used to define the ending temporal values of geometry objects.

dataRoles.name: size
dataRoles.description: Measure to control circle radius size. Must be a numeric or integer type.

dataRoles.name: Gradient
dataRoles.description: Measure to apply qualitative or quantitative color groups to features.

dataRoles.name: tooltips
dataRoles.description: Measures to be displayed when hovering on a feature.

licensingSettings.description: TSS Maps is free to use with a watermark. Organizations can purchase a license key that removes it - contact sales@thesolutionstack.com.

licenseKey.description: The license key provided by The Solution Stack.

forceStateDebug.description: Dev only — forces licenseState directly, bypassing verification and the call-home flow entirely. Has no effect in production builds.

elevationModel.description: Select a standard elevation model service, or 'Custom URL' to use a custom elevation service

elevationCustomUrl.description: Override with the url of a custom elevation layer

bLayer1.description: The default basemap shown when the report opens. Viewers can switch at runtime via the Basemap Gallery widget.

entraSettings.description: Authentication settings for secured ArcGIS layers. Set the Token Broker URL to load AGOL or Enterprise reference layers automatically.

brokerPortal.description: The ArcGIS connection report viewers sign in to via the Token Broker — either an ArcGIS Enterprise portal or ArcGIS Online.

brokerUrl.description: Base URL of the TSS Token Broker (e.g. https://tss-token-broker.azurewebsites.net). Validates the Power BI Entra token and returns a per-user ArcGIS portal token, prompting a one-time account link if needed.

aadTokenDebug.description: Dev only — paste a CLI-obtained Entra access token here to test the broker without AppSource listing. Has no effect in production builds.

spatialReference.description: Use a custom WKID for the spatial reference

srid.description: Spatial reference WKID applied to incoming geometry. Pick from the catalog, or define a Custom WKID below for off-catalog codes.

mapSymbology.description: Settings for how data is displayed in the visualization
mapSymbology.descriptionKey: Settings for how data is displayed in the visualization

useDataColor.description: Use CSS color values from the Color role directly (e.g. #FF0000, rgb(255,0,0), red). When off, a gradient is applied instead.

glow.description: Make features emit light in 3D mode (points, lines, polygons)

glowStrength.description: Controls emissive strength and bloom effect (0-100)

classBreakEditor.description: Interactive slider to adjust color class break boundaries directly on the map

geocode.description: Use geocoding service to locate latitude and longitude of data points

mapTimeSlider.description: Set a time slider for the map

mapExtent.description: Set a home extent for the map

xmin.description: The left boundary of the extent

xmax.description: The right boundary of the extent

useCurrentExtent.description: Set custom extent to the current extent of the map
